name: MangaDex
description: Browse and read manga from MangaDex with configurable chapter languages and image quality.

configs.name: Chapter languages
configs.description: Comma-separated MangaDex language codes, in title preference order (e.g. en,zh-hk). zh is Simplified Chinese, zh-hk is Traditional Chinese.

configs.name: Include mature titles
configs.description: Include erotica and pornographic titles in browsing and search. The Mature genre explicitly searches those ratings.
